title: Russia fires missiles and drones at Kyiv overnight after Putin vows 'painful' revenge for bridge
dek: Fires broke out in two Kyiv districts and infrastructure was hit in Kyiv and Kryvyi Rih. No casualties had been reported by early Friday.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
Russia launched a large overnight missile and drone attack on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities early on Friday, hours after President Vladimir Putin promised retaliation for Ukraine's strikes on the Crimean bridge that would be "far more painful" than the damage to the bridge.

Explosions began in Kyiv at about 1.25 am local time (4.55 am IST), minutes after Ukraine's air force warned of incoming ballistic missiles, and further waves followed until about 4 am, according to reports. The Kyiv City Military Administration reported fires in residential buildings in the Obolonskyi and Podilskyi districts, and Mayor Vitali Klitschko said an infrastructure facility in Holosiivskyi district had been hit. Oleksandr Vilkul, head of the city's defence council, said a "massive" drone attack had hit a major infrastructure facility in Kryvyi Rih. Air defences were also in action over Lviv in the west.

No casualties had been reported by early morning, and Ukraine's air force had not yet published its count of the missiles and drones launched. Figures are expected later on Friday.

Speaking in Shenzhen on Thursday after his meetings with US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping, Mr Putin said that after the bridge strikes Russia would not negotiate, and that Ukraine and Europe were "not yet ready" for compromise, according to reports. A day earlier, a Russian drone attack on Kyiv killed one man and damaged St Volodymyr's Cathedral, according to reports.
